hardware.topology: CCM totem-pole bridgeless PFC, GaN fast leg (LMG3422R030), MOSFET slow leg
hardware.control: C2000 F280049, average current mode, non-isolated current sensing
hardware.switching_frequency_note: NOT STATED in TIDUEZ3B. The 100 kHz and 500 kHz figures in section 3 are current-sense amplifier bandwidth tests, not the PWM rate. Any equivalent-ripple band derived from it would be a guess, so criteria here must not depend on it.

derived_fields.I_active_A: Pin/Vin -- the in-phase (power-carrying) component of the measured input current.
derived_fields.I_ideal_for_Pout_A: Pout/Vin -- what a LOSSLESS unity-PF converter would draw to deliver the same output power.
derived_fields.why_these_exist: The raw measured Iin CANNOT be compared against this model directly. Pin/(Vin*Iin) disagrees with the table's own PF column by -0.072 at light load, converging to 0.000 at full load. Tested 2026-09-13: the gap is explained by a CONSTANT quadrature current of 0.67-0.89 A (mean 0.748 A, implying ~10 uF of X-capacitance) across the full 10:1 load range -- i.e. the hardware's EMI filter, which draws reactive current that carries no power and which this model does not have. At full load that current is 0.1 % of 18.37 A and invisible; at light load it is 41 % of 1.92 A and dominant. Comparing the model's line current against raw Iin would be demanding that an EMI-filter-less model reproduce an EMI filter.
